# Find exact matches for the requested product name
matches = [p for p in all_products if p.get('name')=='Amazon Kindle (9th Generation)']
print('exact_matches_count', len(matches))
# show up to 20 product ids with price, delivery, inventory
# If many, sort by price then delivery_days then product_id
matches_sorted = sorted(matches, key=lambda p: (p.get('price', 0), p.get('delivery_days', 0), p.get('product_id', 0)))
for p in matches_sorted[:20]:
    print(p.get('product_id'), p.get('price'), p.get('delivery_days'), p.get('inventory_quantity'), p.get('color'), p.get('variations'))
# also show min/max price among matches
if matches:
    prices=[p.get('price') for p in matches]
    invs=[p.get('inventory_quantity') for p in matches]
    print('price_range', min(prices), max(prices))
    print('inventory_range', min(invs), max(invs))
